correctness.rationale: The nonsentinel sum follows by inclusion–exclusion on disjoint left and right edge sets for interior sources. Balancing the residual gaps strictly improves their geometric-sum contribution until they differ by at most one. The increment from d to d+1 is p^d(d+1−dp)−p^q with q=floor((n−d)/2). For d≤floor(n/3) it is positive. For the remaining d, k=d−q satisfies 0<k<d and p^k(d+1−dp) rises from zero to a unique interior maximum and then falls strictly to one, proving the single interior crossing. Successive k increase by at least one, and (d+1−dp)−p(d+2−(d+1)p)=(d+1)(1−p)^2>0, giving strictly ordered crossings and no skipped distances. At n=4 the increment normalizes to p(1−p)(2p−1)/2. The analytical proof is universal for the stated model; the inspected frozen rational and edge-subset checks are auxiliary recorded checks, not a new replay.
